name: The Yandere
tagline: 196,956 objects of obsession — clocks, chains, and a whole lot of red.

facts.note: A mega-collaboration hosted, verified and published by Dorami, themed on Yandere Simulator. The song is no longer available on Newgrounds.

theme.mood: Black and arterial red, nothing in between. Ghost clock faces turning behind everything, chains, gears, and a torn paint swash under a title that looks cut rather than typed.

voice.why:
The Yandere is on this list because it commits. Plenty of levels pick a theme and decorate around it; this one builds the whole thing out of a single idea and never blinks. The clocks turning in the background, the chains, the red that never lets up — it all points the same direction.

It also came out in 2019 and still looks like this. Nearly 200,000 objects on a 2.1 level, hosted and verified by the same person, which is its own kind of stubbornness.
